description: The donut chart, titled "Stimulus Type," illustrates the distribution of various input stimulus material types provided by journalists to large language models (LLMs) in the context of WildChat conversations matched to online articles from two news agencies. The chart is composed of eight distinct segments, each representing a different type of stimulus and labeled with its corresponding percentage. The largest segment, colored dark red, represents "Draft/Other" at 26.4%. The second largest is "Press Release" at 18.7%, shown in gold. "External News Article" follows at 18.1%, depicted in dark green. "Interview" accounts for 8.8% and is shown in dark blue. "Organizational Report" makes up 7.7% and is colored purple. "Event Posting" represents 6.6% and is shown in a medium brown. "Intra-agency news article" and "Organizational Website" each account for 4.9% and are represented by light blue and a lighter shade of purple, respectively. The smallest segment is "Social Media Post" at 1.1%, shown in a very thin orange slice. "Email" accounts for 2.7% and is represented by a light green segment. The percentages are clearly labeled next to each corresponding slice, and the chart visually emphasizes the relative proportions of each stimulus type.
